title: Integer / integer is a decimal number even when the quotient is whole

source.quote: In the following table, the row header is the numerator and the column header is the denominator.
source.supports: the Division (/) table of result types: INTEGER/INTEGER is REAL, INTEGER/CURRENCY is CURRENCY, CURRENCY/INTEGER is CURRENCY, CURRENCY/CURRENCY is REAL, CURRENCY/REAL is CURRENCY

source.quote: The result is always decimal, unless a currency is divided by an integer or by a decimal; in this case, the result is currency.
source.supports: the result type of / and of DIVIDE
